## Checklist

- [ ] **Honesty firewall** — one real data stream; no fabricated, estimated, or interpolated values shown as real.
- [ ] **No engagement dark patterns** — no streaks, leaderboards, badges, or FOMO.
- [ ] **Museum, not dashboard** — the change stays calm and editorial; it doesn't clutter or gamify.
- [ ] **Build passes** — TypeScript stays strict (no new `any`); `npm run build` is green.
- [ ] **Screenshots attached** for any UI change (both `nocturne` and `day` themes if relevant).
- [ ] **Licensing understood** — my contribution is licensed **CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0**, and any artwork I add is non-commercial (not for resale by anyone) and mine to license.
